title: Big Sister’s Whereabouts
paragraphs: After arriving in Melromarc through the portal, we insisted on meeting with the queen despite it being late at night.
“…Iwatani-sama and Kitamura-sama, what brings you here at this late hour?”
It’s understandable that the queen looked a little drowsy. Considering the time, of course.
“I apologize for the late hour. I thought we could ask the castle staff, but…”
“That’s right. When it comes to an audience with Iwatani-sama, I had arranged for them to go through me first, so there’s no problem.”
Father kept bowing his head repeatedly.
Is there any need for such deference toward the queen?
“So, what brings you here tonight? I have a feeling that, just like Kawasumi-sama, Kitamura-sama came after hearing something, correct?”
“Ah… yes. Actually—”
Father explained to the queen what I had just told him. Mainly about the villagers from the first world.
“I thought I had seen her somewhere before… So, she was one of Father’s subjects.”
Éclair said this while looking at the older sister of the sisters. It seemed like she had something she wanted to say to her.
“Why didn’t you say anything sooner?”
“Oh my, even if you’re the lord’s daughter, with how chaotic Melromarc was, you didn’t seem to be acting like your father. I felt bad, you know?”
The older sister of the sisters replied nonchalantly, as if nothing had happened. And to top it off, she transformed into her beast form to confirm it for Éclair.
“So, you couldn’t trust me…”
“Oh my?”
Éclair murmured as if giving up. The older sister of the sisters waved her hand as if to deny it, but to me, it looked more like an affirmation.
“In other words, you want to protect the demi-human slaves in our country, is that correct?”
“That’s right.”
Father nodded at the queen’s words.
“The timing is just right. I’ve heard that slave traders do most of their business at night.”
“Well, it’s a profession that thrives away from the public eye. So, could we use your connections, Queen?”
“Please wait a moment.”
The queen seemed to be giving various orders to her subordinates. I’m sure the matter will be resolved soon.

“Given the damage caused by the Three Hero Church and the lingering influence of my daughter’s specter, I can’t guarantee that we’ll find the people you’re looking for, but I will have my people make arrangements.”
“That’s a great help.”

And so, Father, the others, and I followed the guide arranged by the queen to visit the slave traders’ guild located in the castle town. The older sister of the sisters handed over a list where she had meticulously written down the names and races of the villagers.
“Hmm… Slaves from that village in Seatto, huh? If they’ve been traded, it’ll require a tracking investigation, which might take some time.”

However, that day ended with the slave traders merely agreeing to search for them. Apparently, many of the transactions were done without names, using symbols instead. They should implement a registration system like they do with weapons and armor. Moreover, there seem to be quite a few of the Racoon species, the same as the older sister of the sisters, which makes it difficult to pinpoint the exact ones. In that sense, it feels like a miracle that Keel was successfully retrieved through the monster merchant.
Or rather, doesn’t that mean that monster merchant was actually quite capable?
“Yes, yes. A direct request from the Hero. Yes.”
“Y-Yeah… thank you.”
Father looked a bit wary. It brings back memories of the previous loop. Then, he whispered softly into my ear, saying that this person seemed like the Pope of the Four Saint Church.
So, he thinks the same? It’s definitely likely that they are distantly related.
“By the way, Father. In the first world, the person you often talked to was this monster merchant.”
“Really? Then maybe it’s likely I bought from him.”
Father nodded at my words and asked the monster merchant.
Oh? Has he not met this guy before?
Well… come to think of it, there doesn’t seem to have been an opportunity to meet this time. But I did hear that he bought Filo-tan’s egg in Melromarc.
“Um, so I’m looking for a child named Raphtalia and another named Keel…”
“Yes. All the slave traders in Melromarc are conducting a full-scale investigation. Yes.”
“Ah, I see…”

They sure move fast. And so, the search for the sister and the villagers began. With the queen’s backing, the slave traders searched for the villagers desperately. If they found them, they’d probably sell them for a high price. The slave traders even contacted their noble patrons to search, but apparently, a large number of fakes were gathered. For about three days starting from the next day, Father and the older sister of the sisters would go to the slave traders regularly, only to return completely drained.
“They say people are resilient, but I’m speechless at how these merchants try to pass off fakes even when they know we’re looking for people we know.”
“Shall we kill them as an example?”
“Why does it always have to go straight to killing? And… I’d love to buy and help those slaves, but if I start doing that, there’ll be no end to it. It’s really a tough situation.”
“I’m sorry, Naofumi-chan.”

Father shook his head at the words of the older sister of the sisters. That’s right. There’s no need for the older sister of the sisters to apologize. The blame lies entirely with the useless merchants bringing in fakes.
Should we just kill them after all?
“It’s fine, it’s fine. This is something I wanted to do, and they’re the people Sadina wants to protect.”
“Thank you, Naofumi-chan.”
The older sister of the sisters looked genuinely grateful. Meanwhile, Father’s expression remained gloomy.
“Father, you don’t look so well.”
“W-Well, yeah. How should I put it… that incident where the princess turned into a vengeful spirit caused a lot of casualties. It didn’t matter if they were demi-humans, humans, or even nobles.”
What…? This feels unpleasant.

Is that incident still casting its shadow here? Nearly half of Melromarc’s territory was affected. That crimson swine is nothing but a plague on this world. As things progressed, they started finding some of the village slaves… but only about a quarter of the ones I remember from the village have been found. Even Keel, who should have been easy to locate, has left no trace. It seems they’ve been traded in a lot of different places.
“We might have to extend the search range to neighboring countries. It seems a lot of slave traders moved around before that incident.”
“The search seems to be struggling.”

By the way, Ren, Itsuki, and the panda apparently found Fohl fairly quickly. They also found his sister with him, which is a relief. But Father hasn’t gone to see them because he doesn’t really want to get too close.
Is the trauma from that homo suspicion still haunting him? And so, as the fourth day was about to pass…
“Um… the investigation into the person named Raphtalia, whom the Shield Hero was searching for, has been concluded. Yes.”

The monster merchant answered while wiping his sweat. Judging by the atmosphere, Father seems to have a bad feeling and is trembling slightly. Even the older sister of the sisters, who is usually so cheerful, had a very serious expression as she stared at the monster merchant.
“I-I see. W-Well, can you tell us?”
“Yes.”
The monster merchant spread out some documents and began explaining.

“That slave, believed to be Raphtalia, was captured and passed through the hands of multiple slave traders and nobles. There are records of her being traded many times. According to the ledger, I also bought her once. Yes.”
“Really!? Then… she’s with you?”
Father asked, but the monster merchant shook his head.
“Unfortunately, five days after I bought her, she was sold to a new customer. I remember she was already quite weak by that point. Since she was ill, I sold her at a discount. Yes.”
“Tha—”
Before finishing his sentence, Father held himself back. The older sister of the sisters looked like she was faintly crackling with lightning around her body.
Oh… the older sister of the sisters is angry. This is a rare sight. But she managed to contain it. She’s just silently staring.
“After that, the noble who bought her whipped her, and her condition quickly worsened…”
Chapter 739 – Uncertain
“Ugh… ugh…”
Father had turned pale beyond his limit. The older sister of the sisters was speechless and collapsed to the ground.

“After the slave crest’s master registration was canceled, I took care of retrieving the body. According to Melromarc’s slave trade laws, I buried it in the slave cemetery prepared in the nearby forest.”
“I-It’s just that it’s what it ‘seems’ like. So, Sadina, stay strong! Let’s… just go check it out, just to be sure!”
“Yes… you’re right.”
Father tried to console the older sister of the sisters, but she looked like she was trembling slightly.
“However…”
The monster merchant was wiping his sweat, looking apologetic.
What’s wrong now? Father furrowed his brows and shifted his gaze to the monster merchant.
“When the Four Holy Heroes resolved the great incident in Melromarc, countless bodies from the cemetery were turned into undead, so verifying the body may be difficult. Yes.”
This time, Father seemed to reach his limit. He staggered back, and then walked unsteadily toward me, gripping my shoulder. Even I can read the atmosphere sometimes.
“Yeah… I know loops can have developments like this… but this is tough. That girl, Raphtalia… I bet she was really brave. Maybe that’s why Motoyasu mistook her.”
“Yes, indeed. The older sister was very courageous and was a reliable partner to Father.”

I still remember. When Takt had us cornered, the older sister risked her life to help everyone, including me, escape. Back then, the old lady protected her and helped her get away. I also remember how Filo-tan was badly injured. That old lady was brave too. If I recall, she was the older sister’s mentor. I never imagined the older sister would meet such an end. No, we haven’t confirmed that it was her yet.
“Father, you don’t have to say it. I understand. Like Itsuki, if there’s another loop, I will definitely save the older sister.”
“I’m counting on you! I’ll never let something like this happen again!”

I understand. The older sister is also Filo-tan’s older sister. Unlike that stalker pig, she’s someone who should be prioritized. I burned that thought into my brain, adding as many “absolutely” as possible.
“Then, I must remember where the older sister was. Would it be best if Father bought her here?”
“No… I want you to save her as soon as possible! Even if this information turns out to be wrong.”

Yes, that’s true. Even if this information is wrong, we can still plan to retrieve her when she arrives here. If I come here regularly, I might be able to find her. The more options we have, the better. Besides, since there’s no body, there’s no guarantee that it’s really her. We must not lose hope. Father kept encouraging the older sister of the sisters to stay strong. She said she was fine, but she looked a little exhausted.
“If only we could track the slave crest… but if the body is gone, that’s impossible, right?”
“Depending on the soil and other factors, undead can sometimes form, but I never expected it to happen in that cemetery. Yes.”
Searching for bodies that turned into undead from scratch would take an incredible amount of time.

On top of that, with the severe damage they’ve sustained, would it even be possible to identify them? It’s already been two months since then. The bodies of the zombies were gathered in one place and disposed of as part of Melromarc’s reconstruction efforts, so they would be badly decayed by now. It’s impossible to find her.
“Then please tell me the list of owners of the slave who is believed to be the older sister, in chronological order.”
“Here are the results of our investigation. Yes.”

I looked through the documents handed over by the monster merchant. It seems that about a week before I was summoned, she was with a certain noble. That includes the time for transportation. After that, she was with this monster merchant for about a week, then went to her next master, where her condition rapidly deteriorated, and she died… it seems. Incidentally, that noble was a victim of the vengeful spirit of the crimson swine and is already dead. If he weren’t, I would have gone to kill him.
“Then I’ll get the portal ready for that location so we can save her as quickly as possible.”
“Please… even if it turns out to be wrong, please, find that girl no matter what.”
“Understood!”

I engraved Father’s request deeply into my memory. The lack of confirmation that she’s dead is a sign of hope. Since I haven’t found Filo-tan either, I feel even closer to Father and the others now. Around that time, Itsuki and Ren used the portal to come see us at Melromarc’s castle. Father explained the situation to them.
“Um… Naofumi-san, please stay strong.”

Hearing the story about the older sister, who was missing and presumed dead, Itsuki tried to comfort Father. It seems that Itsuki and Ren had been taking care of Fohl. They also used a powerful potion, Yggdrasil Medicine, to heal Fohl’s sister and restore her strength.
“I’m still holding up, but Sadina must be really worried… We’ve had a lot of death reports about the children from the village too…”

To my eyes, the older sister of the sisters seems to be her usual self. But according to Father, she’s extremely worn out. Well, through the tracking investigation, we’ve managed to rescue a few of the village’s slaves. However, it seems that many died due to the incident caused by the vengeful spirit of the crimson swine.
“I see…”
“Still… it’s tough. You know, Motoyasu-kun said she was my reliable partner. Just thinking that such a girl might be dead is…”
“…Are you the Shield Hero?”
Fohl came over and offered his hand as a greeting. Hmm, he seems to have good manners. He’s a little different from the one in the first world.
“I will fight to repay you for saving Atla. I’ll be in your care from now on.”
Father lightly shook Fohl’s outstretched hand, but his expression was a bit complicated.
“Um… nice to meet you. If possible, I’d like you to follow Ren and Itsuki’s instructions.”
“Hm? Got it.”
Fohl tilted his head. It seems he sensed something was off.
“Alright, Atla, shall we go?”
“Yes, Brother.”

Oh, the little sister seems to be doing well too. She’s still being carried by Fohl, though. But she doesn’t look so weak that she needs to be carried. I think she could walk just fine. As I was thinking that, the queen arrived.
“Ah, Amaki-sama, Kawasumi-sama… I’m sorry that this report brought such unfortunate news.”
“No, no, it’s not confirmed that Naofumi-san’s companion has passed away yet.”
“That’s right. Please use every information network available.”
“Understood. As queen, I will do everything I can to ensure that the demi-humans of the Seatto territory can return to their normal lives as soon as possible.”
At that point, the queen turned her gaze to Fohl and his sister.
“Oh? Are these new companions?”
“Yes… They’re of the Hakuko race, which has a deep connection with Melromarc…”
“I felt a bit uneasy about it, but I thought it would be best to report directly to Naofumi and Motoyasu that they’ve successfully joined us.”
The queen stared intently at Fohl and his sister.
Is something wrong?
“This is… I see.”
“W-What is it?”
“Did you notice something? I don’t quite understand.”
“Come to think of it, Atla-san speaks a bit like Yuki-san, doesn’t she?”
Yuki-chan, who had been quiet, tilted her head at that. She wasn’t hiding, just quietly standing by my side.
“Do I?”
“Brother, do I really sound similar?”
Fohl shook his head.
“There’s no way she sounds the same. Atla is Atla.”
“Motoyasu-sama, do I resemble that person?”

Yuki-chan asked me. Not at all, I think. Honestly, if I recall correctly from the first world, that little sister was such a handful that even Father found her bothersome, and both Ren and Itsuki struggled with her. In the end, she turned out to be a remarkable person, but aside from that, she was practically a pig in my opinion. Back then, I seriously unleashed my skills on her a few times. Though she skillfully deflected them.
“I don’t think you’re similar at all.”
Yuki-chan has elegance and grace. Fohl’s sister is more like a wild child. From what I recall of the first world, she was quite hot-blooded, so there’s no way they’re alike.
